rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when adding something onto or into something else.

example.english: We tack a little pepper onto the soup.
example.traditional: 我哋喺湯入面加落去少少胡椒粉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 tong1 jap6 min6 gaa1 lok6 heoi3 siu2 siu2 wu4 ziu1 fan2

rows.note: Use this specifically when fastening something with a small flat-headed drawing pin rather than an ordinary nail.

example.english: Tack the poster up first so the wind does not blow it away.
example.traditional: 你用圖釘釘住張海報先，唔好畀風吹走。
example.jyutping: nei5 jung6 tou4 deng1 deng1 zyu6 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 sin1 m4 hou2 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 zau2
